question: Each of six students, A, B, C, D, E and F, have their class monitor duties on six different days of a week starting from Monday and ending on Saturday of the same week, but not necessarily in the same order. A’s monitor duties are on the day immediately after C. D’s monitor duties are on the day immediately before E, but it is not on Monday. B’s monitor duties are on Saturday. F’s monitor duties are on Wednesday. Who among the following has monitor duties on Tuesday?
solution:
Given: Each of six students, A, B, C, D, E and F, have their class monitor duties on six different days of a week starting from Monday and ending on Saturday of the same week, but not necessarily in the same order.

1) B’s monitor duties are on Saturday.

2) F’s monitor duties are on Wednesday.
